zh: 深化文献标识、阅读记录与订阅去重。文献记录增加 DOI、arXiv 主 id 与版本、预印本/正式发表/其他形态、版本关联与阅读条目；阅读条目保存稳定的 id、实际读到的章节或页码、笔记、理解、疑问、待复现事项与日期，问题可转成行动项，同一条目重复转时回到已有事项。文献卡可编辑这些字段、逐条记录阅读位置，阶段仍由用户维护，读了几节不会自动算全文已读。文献追踪卡保存订阅名称、查询条件、来源与分类；查询留空时按分类组成 cat:<分类>，宿主把默认值里的占位符再展开一层，旧卡片只存分类也照旧读得到。加入工作台先按 DOI、再按 arXiv 主 id、再按来源地址（忽略版本号）查重，标题相近只作候选；撞上重复时预览原因与双方字段，由用户选择保留现有、补充缺失字段、建立版本关系或仍要加入，不从同标题直接删除记录。全部加入逐条进行，需要确认的行留给用户，失败的那一条把原因写在按钮提示里。记录规格、检索、导出导入与内置组件画廊同步覆盖。
en: Deepens literature identifiers, reading entries and subscription deduplication. Literature records now carry DOI, arXiv main id and version, a preprint/published/other format, version links and reading entries; each reading entry keeps a stable id, the sections or pages actually read, notes, understanding, questions, items to reproduce and a date, and a question can become an action that returns to the same item when converted again. The literature card edits these fields and records reading positions one by one; the stage stays user-maintained, so reading a few sections never marks the whole paper understood. The paper feed saves a subscription name, query, source and category; an empty query falls back to cat:<category>, the host expands placeholders inside prop defaults one more round, and old cards that only stored a category keep working. Adding to the board checks DOI first, then the arXiv main id, then the source address ignoring its version, with similar titles only offered as candidates; a match opens a field-by-field preview where the user keeps the existing record, fills its missing fields, links the two as versions or adds anyway, and a shared title never deletes a record outright. Add all writes one row at a time, leaves rows that need a choice to the user and puts the failure reason on the row's button. The record spec, search, export/import and the built-in gallery all cover the new fields.
